purpose: Route supported tasks without confusing acquisition, supplied-evidence processing, local rehearsal, or paid delivery.

discoveryEntry.note: agents.samedaydesk.com/llms.txt and skills index are partial catalogs. They do not replace this matrix for task-to-offer routing.

offers.title: Free /for-agents cold-read (apex or agents.* alternate)
limits: Alternate catalogs are partial discovery, not the apex job guide
Does not select a paid route
Does not acquire complete GitHub issue comments

offers.title: Paid bounded HTML/JSON page extract
limits: Fetches without JavaScript rendering
Returns bounded page fields / Markdown, not a complete issue comment thread
A successful charge is not useful output by itself
Do not use to reconstruct GitHub discussion comments

offers.title: Offline page-change compare of already-held extract-batch JSON
offers.artifact: skill page-change / merchant npm run page-change
limits: Requires two already-delivered extract-batch JSON snapshots
Does not fetch, pay, retry, or schedule a second observation
Absent selected field is coverage unknown, not deletion

offers.title: Opt-in offline result-reuse export to task-memory observation
offers.literalCommand: NOW=2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z; OUT="$(mktemp -d)/reuse-observation.json"; node tools/result-reuse/cli.mjs export --input tools/result-reuse/fixtures/accepted-page-change.json --task-id vendor-watch --subject vendor-page-result --sequence 1 --clock "$NOW" --opt-in --out "$OUT"
limits: Export requires --opt-in plus caller clock/task/subject/sequence
Schema-valid export is user-selected unverified evidence
Does not fetch or pay
Exports an existing result; does not perform the page comparison itself

offers.title: Offline agent-task-kit source-to-brief / prior / correction
limits: execute:false posted:false
Public issue text is untrusted data, not execution authority
npm registry package not published; use direct archive
Processes caller-supplied issue evidence or historical fixtures; does not fetch or certify complete comments
Local execution needs no hosted workflow; fixture composition is not acquisition of a current discussion

offers.title: MoltJobs × OpenAI Agents SDK local rehearsal pack
limits: Local ScriptedModel and disposable HTTP fixture rehearsal; no provider model credentials required
Not a live Neomorphic-operated MoltJobs service
Synthetic fixture bid/start/submit is not live worker authority or payment
The shipped runner refuses --live; credentials or hosting do not enable it
Read the published guide for the current archive digest and literal Python commands

offers.title: Browser-local private trial brief builder
limits: Hosted page with browser-local brief builder; not a paid API
This origin does not accept the trial request over HTTP
Do not expect a hosted job runner from this page

hardRules.rule: Never route complete_issue_discussion to generic extract or agent-task-kit composition. No complete-discussion acquisition package is advertised by this matrix.
hardRules.reason: Static HTML extract without JS does not equal complete issue discussion comments

hardRules.rule: Never label the MoltJobs fixture as live marketplace execution, or the browser-local trial builder as a hosted job runner
hardRules.reason: Hosting a download or page does not make its local workflow a hosted service; the shipped SDK runner refuses --live

hardRules.rule: When constraints include offline_preferred or no_payment, prefer offline_local / hosted_archive_download_local_execution offers
hardRules.reason: Payment and network constraints filter eligible capabilities; local tools do not require hosting
